entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Block `dotnet publish` for stable .NET versions with Preview SDK #49777
  • Please remove annoying preview message #49776
  • dotnet publish AnyCPU #49766
  • [NETSDKE2E] [Regression] Unable to search NuGet package in VS Code. #49765
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With 10.0.100-preview.7.25363.101, .NET crashes when running 'dotnet nuget locals all --clear' #49764
  • Static `dotnet test` command-line options and ability to break in future MTP versions #49763
  • Request for a Lightweight .NET-Only IDE (Non-GUI Focused) #49762

Closed

  • Login without docker login call for dotnet PublishContainer #49768
  • Templates missing from `dotnet new list` #49741

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/9.0.3xx] Disable Registry Related Containers Tests #49774
  • Disable Registry Related Containers Tests #49773
    Area-Infrastructure
  • make SdkResolver try to locate the dotnet host closest to the resolved SDK #49772
    Area-SdkResolvers, Area-NetSDK, Area-MSBuild
  • allow reading uid from ContainerUser to set the Tar entry uid #49770
    Area-Containers
  • Add support for flat launch settings #49769
    Area-run-file
  • Override default properties with custom file-level directives #49767
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Update branding for 9.0.304 #49771
  • Cleanup dotnet test #49734
    Area-dotnet test
  • make containers net472 target resilient to incorrectly-determined DOTNET_HOST_PATH values #49736
    Area-SdkResolvers, Area-Containers, 10.0.1xx
  • Fix indentation in NamedPipeServer.cs #49755
  • Delete unused `MSBuildBuildAndRestoreSettings` #49757
  • Remove empty `#if` #49758
  • Cleanup dead module message serializer #49759

Updated

  • Add support for CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting via Windows SDK build number #49721
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Remove env var workaround that causes dotnet to use MSBuild out-of-proc #49750
    Area-CLI, Area-MSBuild
  • Automatically cleanup old artifacts of file-based apps #49666
    Area-run-file
  • push improved MSBuildLogger to a separate project in case we want to spin it off #49751
    Area-CLI, Area-MSBuild
  • Create .vsconfig #49746
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49740
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Skip MSBuild and call only CSC for simple file-based apps #49528
    Area-run-file, 10.0.1xx
  • Implement `#:package` manipulation for file-based apps #49635
    Area-run-file
  • Make `dotnet project convert` interactive #49660
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #49724
  • Cleanup PipeNameDescription #49756
  • Use BuildManager.Build API and a custom msbuild logger to store props #49728
  • Use IConfigurationBuilder, IConfiguration, and Typed Configuration to centralize the way we manage CLI behaviors #49761
    Area-CLI, config-system-candidate
